THE NAMED NEXT AXIS, with the map already derived so the next session does not re-derive it: declare a file-local view record over sItemRuntime whose members are PARALLEL COLUMN ARRAYS indexed by the loop counter i (stride 4, so 600/4 = 150 entries per column), with columns observed at byte offsets 0, 600, 1200, 1800, 2400 and 29216, and respell the accesses as `irt->col[i]` array references rather than cast arithmetic. Semantics inferable from use: +0 is the accumulated value written into node+52 (a Y position) and incremented by delta; +600 is an offset added to it; +1200 and +1800 are the two target values selected by the st&0x20 open/closed bit; +2400 is the distance compared against sItemSearchDistance; +29216 is the WorldObj* pointer column. The 26216-byte gap between 3000 and 29216 is unmapped. This is a whole-TU pass (shared base, 46 functions) and needs its own claim and gate, which is why it was not started here.
